g_codes.name: Rapid Positioning
g_codes.description: Moves tool at maximum rapid rate to specified position. Not for cutting.
g_codes.warning: No material removal. Confirm clearance before rapid moves.

g_codes.name: Linear Interpolation
g_codes.description: Straight-line feed move at programmed feedrate.

g_codes.name: Circular Interpolation CW
g_codes.description: Clockwise circular arc motion.
g_codes.syntax: G02 X_ Y_ I_ J_ F_  or  G02 X_ Y_ R_ F_

g_codes.name: Circular Interpolation CCW
g_codes.description: Counter-clockwise circular arc motion.
g_codes.syntax: G03 X_ Y_ I_ J_ F_  or  G03 X_ Y_ R_ F_

g_codes.name: Dwell
g_codes.description: Pause program for specified time. P value is milliseconds (Haas) or seconds (Sinumerik).
g_codes.warning: P unit differs between Haas (ms) and Sinumerik (s).

g_codes.name: Exact Stop (Non-Modal)
g_codes.description: Single-block exact stop. Decelerates to zero before proceeding to next block.

g_codes.name: Programmable Data Input
g_codes.description: Allows work offsets and tool offsets to be set from within the program.
g_codes.syntax: G10 L2 P1 X_ Y_ Z_ (set G54)  |  G10 L1 P_ R_ Z_ (set tool offset)
g_codes.warning: G10 permanently modifies offset tables. Double-check values before running.

g_codes.name: XY Plane Select
g_codes.description: Select XY as the active interpolation plane. Default for most milling operations.

g_codes.name: XZ Plane Select
g_codes.description: Select XZ as the active interpolation plane.

g_codes.name: YZ Plane Select
g_codes.description: Select YZ as the active interpolation plane.

g_codes.name: Imperial Units (Haas)
g_codes.description: Set units to inches. All subsequent values in inches.
g_codes.warning: Affects all axis values, feedrates, and offsets.

g_codes.name: Metric Units
g_codes.description: Set units to millimeters.

g_codes.name: Return to Reference Point
g_codes.description: Return to machine home position via intermediate point.
g_codes.warning: Always use G91 G28 Z0 to safely retract Z before XY home.

g_codes.name: Return from Reference Point
g_codes.description: Move from reference point to the intermediate point used in G28.
g_codes.warning: Use after G28 to return to the work area.

g_codes.name: Return to 2nd Reference Point
g_codes.description: Return to the second reference point (often used for tool change position).

g_codes.name: Skip Function (Probing)
g_codes.description: Feed move that stops when a skip signal is received — used for probing.
g_codes.warning: Requires a probing input signal. Do not use without a probe connected.

g_codes.name: Cancel Tool Radius Compensation
g_codes.description: Turn off cutter radius compensation (G41/G42).

g_codes.name: Tool Radius Comp Left
g_codes.description: Compensate tool radius to the left of programmed path.
g_codes.warning: Must be engaged during a linear move (G01).

g_codes.name: Tool Radius Comp Right
g_codes.description: Compensate tool radius to the right of programmed path.
g_codes.warning: Must be engaged during a linear move (G01).

g_codes.name: Tool Length Compensation + (Haas)
g_codes.description: Apply positive tool length offset from offset table.
g_codes.warning: H value must match tool number in offset table.

g_codes.name: Tool Length Compensation - (Haas)
g_codes.description: Apply negative tool length offset (rarely used).
g_codes.warning: Reverses direction of tool length compensation.

g_codes.name: Cancel Tool Length Compensation
g_codes.description: Cancel active tool length offset.

g_codes.name: Maximum Spindle Speed Clamp (CSS)
g_codes.description: Sets maximum RPM limit when using G96 CSS (constant surface speed).
g_codes.warning: Always program G50 S_max before G96 to prevent runaway RPM at small diameters.

g_codes.name: Scaling
g_codes.description: Scales programmed coordinates by a factor relative to a specified center.
g_codes.syntax: G51 X_ Y_ Z_ P_ (Haas: P=scale factor × 1000)
g_codes.warning: Cancel with G50 (Haas) or SCALE OFF (Sinumerik).

g_codes.name: Local Coordinate System Shift
g_codes.description: Shifts the current work coordinate system by a specified amount.
g_codes.warning: Cancel with G52 X0 Y0 Z0 at end of operation.

g_codes.name: Work Coordinate System 1
g_codes.description: Select work offset G54. Most common WCS for first setup.

g_codes.name: Work Coordinate System 2
g_codes.description: Select work offset G55.

g_codes.name: Work Coordinate System 3
g_codes.description: Select work offset G56.

g_codes.name: Work Coordinate System 4
g_codes.description: Select work offset G57.

g_codes.name: Work Coordinate System 5
g_codes.description: Select work offset G58.

g_codes.name: Work Coordinate System 6
g_codes.description: Select work offset G59.

g_codes.name: Exact Stop Mode
g_codes.description: All moves decelerate to exact stop before starting next block. Reduces corner rounding.
g_codes.warning: Slows cycle time significantly. Use G64 for general machining.

g_codes.name: Tapping Mode (Haas)
g_codes.description: Enables rigid tapping. Synchronizes spindle and feed.

g_codes.name: Cutting Mode (Continuous Path)
g_codes.description: Default path blending mode. Allows cornering without exact stop for faster machining.

g_codes.name: Macro Subprogram Call (Non-Modal)
g_codes.description: Call a custom macro program with arguments.

g_codes.name: Macro Subprogram Call (Modal)
g_codes.description: Modal macro call — executes on every subsequent motion block.
g_codes.warning: Cancel with G67 when done.

g_codes.name: Cancel Modal Macro Call
g_codes.description: Cancels a modal macro call set by G66.

g_codes.name: Coordinate Rotation
g_codes.description: Rotates the coordinate system by a specified angle around the selected plane.
g_codes.syntax: G68 X_ Y_ R_ (Haas: R = rotation angle in degrees)
g_codes.warning: Cancel with G69 at end of rotated operation.

g_codes.name: Cancel Coordinate Rotation
g_codes.description: Cancels coordinate rotation set by G68.

g_codes.name: High-Speed Peck Drilling
g_codes.description: Peck drilling with partial retract (chip breaking). Tool does not fully retract between pecks.
g_codes.syntax: G73 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ Q_ F_  (Q = peck increment)
g_codes.warning: Chips may not fully clear hole. Use G83 for deep holes in difficult materials.

g_codes.name: Left-Hand Tapping Cycle
g_codes.description: Left-hand tapping (counter-clockwise thread). Reverses spindle at bottom.
g_codes.syntax: G74 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ F_
g_codes.warning: F must equal RPM × pitch (mm). Incorrect F breaks taps.

g_codes.name: Fine Boring Cycle
g_codes.description: Boring cycle that orients spindle and shifts tool before retracting to avoid scratching bore wall.
g_codes.syntax: G76 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ Q_ P_ F_  (Q = shift distance)
g_codes.warning: Requires oriented spindle stop capability.

g_codes.name: Cancel Canned Cycle
g_codes.description: Cancels any active canned cycle (drilling, tapping, etc.).

g_codes.name: Drilling Canned Cycle
g_codes.description: Simple drilling cycle: drill to depth, rapid out.
g_codes.syntax: G81 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ F_

g_codes.name: Spot Drilling / Drilling with Dwell
g_codes.description: Drilling with a dwell at the bottom. Used for spotting, countersinking, or controlled depth.
g_codes.syntax: G82 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ P_ F_  (P = dwell in ms)

g_codes.name: Peck Drilling Cycle
g_codes.description: Deep hole peck drilling with full retract to R plane between pecks.
g_codes.syntax: G83 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ Q_ F_  (Q = peck depth)

g_codes.name: Tapping Cycle
g_codes.description: Right-hand tapping cycle. Feedrate must match: F = RPM × Pitch.
g_codes.syntax: G84 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ F_
g_codes.warning: Calculate F carefully: F = RPM × Pitch (mm). Wrong F breaks taps.

g_codes.name: Boring — Feed In, Feed Out
g_codes.description: Boring cycle that feeds both in and out. Leaves a good finish on both passes.
g_codes.syntax: G85 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ F_

g_codes.name: Boring — Stop Spindle, Rapid Out
g_codes.description: Boring cycle: feeds to depth, stops spindle, retracts rapidly.
g_codes.syntax: G86 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ F_
g_codes.warning: May leave a witness mark. Use G76 for fine bores.

g_codes.name: Boring — Feed In, Dwell, Feed Out
g_codes.description: Boring cycle with dwell at depth, then feed out.
g_codes.syntax: G89 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ P_ F_  (P = dwell in ms)

g_codes.name: Absolute Programming
g_codes.description: All coordinates measured from program zero (WCS origin).

g_codes.name: Incremental Programming
g_codes.description: All coordinates measured from current position.
g_codes.warning: Easy source of crashes. Verify incremental values carefully.

g_codes.name: Set Work Coordinate Origin
g_codes.description: Shifts the active WCS so that current position equals the programmed coordinates.
g_codes.warning: G92 is a local shift — cancel with G92 X0 Y0 Z0.

g_codes.name: Inverse Time Feed Rate Mode
g_codes.description: Feedrate F specifies feed in inverse time (blocks per minute). Used with 5-axis moves.
g_codes.warning: F must be re-programmed every block.

g_codes.name: Feed per Minute Mode
g_codes.description: Feedrate in mm/min or in/min. Default mode.

g_codes.name: Feed per Revolution Mode
g_codes.description: Feedrate in mm/rev or in/rev. Commonly used in turning.

g_codes.name: Constant Surface Speed (CSS)
g_codes.description: Spindle speed varies to maintain constant cutting speed as diameter changes. Used in turning.
g_codes.syntax: G96 S_ (CSS value in m/min or SFM)
g_codes.warning: Always program G50 S_max before G96 to limit maximum RPM.

g_codes.name: Constant RPM Mode
g_codes.description: Spindle speed is constant RPM regardless of diameter.

g_codes.name: Return to Initial Plane (Canned Cycles)
g_codes.description: After canned cycle, retract Z to initial Z height (before cycle started).
g_codes.syntax: G98 G81 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ F_

g_codes.name: Return to R Plane (Canned Cycles)
g_codes.description: After canned cycle, retract Z only to R plane. Faster for repeated holes.
g_codes.syntax: G99 G83 X_ Y_ Z_ R_ Q_ F_
g_codes.warning: Ensure clearance between holes when using G99 with fixtures.

m_codes.name: Program Stop
m_codes.description: Unconditional program stop. Requires operator to press Cycle Start to continue.

m_codes.name: Optional Stop
m_codes.description: Program stop only if Optional Stop switch is ON at control.

m_codes.name: End of Program
m_codes.description: End program execution. Rewinds to beginning.

m_codes.name: Spindle CW
m_codes.description: Start spindle clockwise (standard for milling right-hand tools).

m_codes.name: Spindle CCW
m_codes.description: Start spindle counter-clockwise (left-hand tools or special operations).

m_codes.name: Spindle Stop
m_codes.description: Stop spindle rotation.

m_codes.name: Tool Change (Haas)
m_codes.description: Execute tool change to tool in spindle. Tool number specified by T word.
m_codes.warning: Always ensure Z is at safe height before M06.

m_codes.name: Mist Coolant On
m_codes.description: Turn on mist (air/oil) coolant.

m_codes.name: Flood Coolant On
m_codes.description: Turn on flood coolant.

m_codes.name: Coolant Off
m_codes.description: Turn off all coolant.

m_codes.name: 4th Axis Clamp
m_codes.description: Clamp the rotary (4th) axis.

m_codes.name: 4th Axis Unclamp
m_codes.description: Unclamp the rotary (4th) axis.
m_codes.warning: Ensure tool is clear of part before unclamping.

m_codes.name: Spindle Orientation
m_codes.description: Orient spindle to a fixed angular position. Required before tool changes and boring with shift.

m_codes.name: Mirror X Axis
m_codes.description: Activates X axis mirroring for part programs.
m_codes.warning: Cancel with M23 at end of mirrored section.

m_codes.name: Mirror Y Axis
m_codes.description: Activates Y axis mirroring for part programs.
m_codes.warning: Cancel with M24 at end of mirrored section.

m_codes.name: Mirror X Off
m_codes.description: Cancels X axis mirroring.

m_codes.name: Mirror Y Off
m_codes.description: Cancels Y axis mirroring.

m_codes.name: End of Program (Reset)
m_codes.description: End program and reset to beginning. Standard end-of-program code.

m_codes.name: Spindle Low Gear
m_codes.description: Select low gear range on geared-head machines.

m_codes.name: Spindle High Gear
m_codes.description: Select high gear range on geared-head machines.

m_codes.name: High Pressure Coolant On
m_codes.description: Turn on through-spindle or high-pressure coolant (if equipped).
m_codes.warning: Verify HPC is appropriate for current operation.

m_codes.name: High Pressure Coolant Off
m_codes.description: Turn off high pressure coolant.

m_codes.name: Subprogram Call (Haas)
m_codes.description: Call a subprogram. P is program number, L is repeat count.

m_codes.name: Subprogram Return (Haas)
m_codes.description: Return from subprogram to calling program.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Drilling
sinumerik_cycles.description: Simple drilling without chip breaking. Drill to depth and retract.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Drilling with Dwell
sinumerik_cycles.description: Drilling with dwell at bottom of hole.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: CYCLE82(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, DTB)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Deep Hole Drilling
sinumerik_cycles.description: Deep hole drilling with peck and chip breaking.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: CYCLE83(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, FDEP, FDPR, DAM, DTB, DTS, FRF, VARI)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Rigid Tapping
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: CYCLE84(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, DTB, SDAC, MPIT, PIT, POSS, SST, SST1)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Boring 1 (Reaming)
sinumerik_cycles.description: Boring/reaming cycle with feed in and programmable feed out.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: CYCLE85(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, DTB, FFR, RFF)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Thread Cutting (Flexible Tapping)
sinumerik_cycles.description: Thread cutting without synchronization (floating tap holder required).
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: CYCLE840(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, DTB, SDR, SDAC, ENC, MPIT, PIT)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Boring 2 (With Shift)
sinumerik_cycles.description: Boring with oriented spindle stop and shift before retract — prevents scratch on bore wall.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: CYCLE86(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, DTB, SDIR, RPA, RPO, RPAP, POSS)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Rectangular Pocket Milling
sinumerik_cycles.description: Milling of rectangular pockets with roughing and finishing passes.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: POCKET3(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, LENG, WID, CRAD, PA, PO, STA, MID, FAL, FALD, FFP1, FFD, CDIR, VARI, ...)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Circular Pocket Milling
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: POCKET4(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, PRAD, PA, PO, MID, FAL, FALD, FFP1, FFD, CDIR, VARI, ...)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Thread Milling
sinumerik_cycles.description: Helical thread milling cycle using a thread milling cutter.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax: CYCLE90(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, DIATH, KDIAM, PIT, FFR, CDIR, TYPTH, CPA, CPO)

sinumerik_cycles.name: Modal Cycle Call
sinumerik_cycles.description: Activates a cycle modally so it executes at every subsequent position block.
sinumerik_cycles.syntax:
MCALL CYCLE81(...)  ; then list positions
MCALL  ; to deactivate
sinumerik_cycles.warning: Always deactivate with MCALL (no arguments) when done.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Spindle Position
sinumerik_cycles.description: Position the spindle to an exact angle. Used before oriented operations.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Programmable Zero Offset (Absolute)
sinumerik_cycles.description: Shifts the current workpiece coordinate system by an absolute value.
sinumerik_cycles.warning: Cancel with TRANS (no arguments) at end of shifted section.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Programmable Zero Offset (Additive)
sinumerik_cycles.description: Shifts the WCS additively on top of an existing TRANS or frame.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Coordinate Rotation
sinumerik_cycles.description: Rotates the active coordinate frame around the selected plane axis.

sinumerik_cycles.name: Scaling
sinumerik_cycles.description: Scales the coordinate system by a specified factor per axis.
sinumerik_cycles.warning: Cancel with SCALE X1 Y1 Z1.
